subject: Kickoff - seq2seq coref as the multilingual backbone
body:
Hi all,

Formally kicking off coref_mt5. The pitch: instead of searching over candidate spans, we treat coreference as a text-to-text transition system on mT5 and predict mentions and links jointly. Our open-source version reports 83.3 F1 on CoNLL-2012, which is state of the art, and because the backbone is multilingual T5 we get non-English for free-ish rather than as a separate model per language.

Product angle: document understanding has been asking for entity threading across long contracts and support transcripts in six languages. One model instead of six is the whole business case.

Window is Apr 13 - Jul 27. Checkpoints:
- May 15: decoder running against our own checkpoint server, English parity with the published F1.
- Jun 26: two non-English languages measured, serving path benchmarked.
- Jul 20: launch review packet.

Daniela has staffing. Yusuf is tech lead.

Priya
